newsitem.title: USA: Peoples Heritage to tender 2.5 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Peoples Heritage to tender 2.5 mln shrs.

text.p: Peoples Heritage Financial Group Inc said Tuesday it has begun a tender offer to buy up to 2.5 million shares, or about 9.9 percent of its outstanding common stock, from shareholders.

The company said the offer is a dutch auction allowing shareholders to tender their shares at a price no greater than $24 per share and no less than $21 per share. The company said it will pay its set price for all shares.
If more than the maximum number of shares sought is tendered at or below its set price, shares will be prorated, the company said.
The company said it is making the tender offer in connection with its proposed acquisition of Family Bancorp, which it expects to complete by year end.
Peoples Heritage said it will be able to issue a maximum of 5,572,001 shares of common stock once the purchase of Family Bancorp is complete.

The company said the common stock to be issued to Family shareholders pursuant to the acquisition are not eligible to be tendered in the offer. The tender and the acquisition are unconditional upon one another, the company added.
